UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Stores user-specific settings, preferences, and configurations for the earning tracker, including fuel details and targets.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity (matches userId).

petrolPrice.description: The price of petrol per liter (₹).

mileage.description: The mileage of the user's bike in kilometers per liter (km/l).

dailyGoal.description: The user's daily earning target in rupees (₹).

autoFuelCalc.description: Whether automatic fuel cost calculation is enabled.

DeliveryLog.title: DeliveryLog
DeliveryLog.description: Represents a single log entry for a delivery session or a day's work, detailing earnings, distance covered, online hours, and associated costs.

id.description: Unique identifier for the DeliveryLog entity.

logDate.description: The specific date of this delivery log entry.

numberOfOrders.description: The total number of orders completed during this delivery log entry.

earnings.description: Total earnings in rupees (₹) from deliveries for this log entry.

incentive.description: Total incentives or bonuses received for this log entry.

distanceKm.description: Total distance covered in kilometers (km) for deliveries during this log entry.

onlineHours.description: Total hours spent online for deliveries during this log entry.

tips.description: Total tips received in rupees (₹) for deliveries during this log entry.

fuelCost.description: The fuel cost in rupees (₹) for this delivery log entry. This can be auto-calculated based on distance and user settings or manually overridden by the user.

otherExpensesAmount.description: Manual expenses in rupees (₹) directly associated with this delivery log entry, such as tolls, parking, or specific operational costs for the session.

netProfit.description: The calculated net profit in rupees (₹) for this delivery log entry (Earnings + Tips + Incentive - Fuel Cost - Other Expenses).

notes.description: Optional notes or remarks pertaining to this specific delivery log entry.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when this delivery log entry was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when this delivery log entry was last updated.

GeneralExpense.title: GeneralExpense
GeneralExpense.description: Tracks broader, general expenses (e.g., food, vehicle maintenance) that are not directly tied to a specific delivery log entry.

id.description: Unique identifier for the GeneralExpense entity.

expenseDate.description: The specific date when the general expense was incurred.

category.description: The category of the expense (e.g., 'Food', 'Maintenance', 'Other') for detailed tracking.

amount.description: The amount in rupees (₹) of the general expense.

description.description: Optional description or notes for this general expense entry.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when this general expense was recorded.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when this general expense was last updated.

definition.description: Stores a single user's profile settings, preferences, and configurations. It is strictly owned by the {userId} specified in the path.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique ID of the user.

params.name: profileId
params.description: The unique ID for the profile document (usually 'settings').

definition.description: A subcollection holding all delivery log entries for a specific user.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique ID of the user who owns this delivery log.

params.name: deliveryLogId
params.description: The unique ID for a specific delivery log entry.

definition.description: A subcollection for general expenses not tied to specific deliveries, belonging to a specific user.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique ID of the user who owns this general expense.

params.name: generalExpenseId
params.description: The unique ID for a specific general expense entry.

firestore.reasoning: The design prioritizes strong user data isolation and simplified security rules by implementing a hierarchical, user-owned data structure. Each user's data, including their UserProfile, DeliveryLog entries, and GeneralExpense records, resides exclusively within a dedicated path under their unique user ID.
